lines.beaver: 박 선생님, 오늘은 병의 위험을 알려 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Dr. Park, could you tell us about the risks of disease today?
lines.beaver_roman: bak seonsaengnim, oneureun byeongui wiheomeul allyeo jusigetseumnikka?
lines.en: Yes. They say stress is the root of all diseases.

lines.beaver_en: What disease do people worry about most these days?
lines.en: Lifestyle diseases. They need steady management.

lines.learner: 네, 운동과 규칙적인 식사로 예방할 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, exercise and regular meals can prevent them.
lines.roman: ne, undonggwa gyuchikjeogin siksaro yebanghal su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is low blood pressure dangerous too?
lines.learner: 네, 저혈압이 심하면 쓰러질 수도 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, severe low blood pressure can make you faint.
lines.roman: ne, jeohyeorabi simhamyeon sseureojil sudo itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is numbness in the hands and feet dangerous?
lines.learner: 계속 심하게 저리면 마비가 올 수도 있습니다.
lines.en: If the numbness stays severe, paralysis can follow.
lines.roman: gyesok simhage jeorimyeon mabiga ol sudo itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How should we describe our symptoms?
lines.learner: 병명을 몰라도 아픈 곳을 정확히 말하면 됩니다.
lines.en: Even without knowing the disease name, just say exactly where it hurts.
lines.roman: byeongmyeongeul mollado apeun goseul jeonghwaki malhamyeon doemnida.

lines.beaver_en: There are many gastritis patients too, right?
lines.learner: 네, 못 먹을 지경인 위염 환자도 많습니다.
lines.en: Yes, many gastritis patients can barely eat.
lines.roman: ne, mon meogeul jigyeongin wiyeom hwanjado manseumnida.

lines.learner: 기침이나 손으로 옮으니 손을 자주 씻으세요.
lines.en: It spreads by coughs or hands, so wash your hands often.
lines.roman: gichimina soneuro olmeuni soneul jaju ssiseuseyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about small burns or wounds?
lines.learner: 작은 상처도 그냥 두면 덧나서 심해질 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Even small wounds can worsen if left alone.
lines.roman: jageun sangcheodo geunyang dumyeon deonnaseo simhaejil su itseumnida.

lines.learner: 충치든 큰 병이든 일찍 치료하세요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Cavities or serious illness, treat them early. Thank you.
lines.roman: chungchideun keun byeongideun iljjik chiryohaseyo. gamsahamnida.
